boxes.label: FIZZ2.EXE main
boxes.text: Parses the switches, sets the x87 control word, hooks IRQ 0 (and IRQ 1 for /LIVE), runs the rules at 60 steps a second, hands each cluck to the audio service, and prints the transcript and the platform lines. Checked by `tools/check-dos.sh` in headless DOSBox.

boxes.label: Episode 2 game
boxes.text: The program plays one small slice level. The rest of the game, with its levels, gadgets, enemies and menus, is planned.

boxes.label: fizz-sim
boxes.text: `no_std`, no `unsafe`, no platform types. Host tests, and the same hash on native, Web and DOS.

boxes.label: fizz-phys
boxes.text: Fizz 1's physics as an owned `no_std` crate. `tools/lf-sim-drift.sh` compares it with Fizz 1's source.

boxes.label: fizz-ep2
boxes.sub: Ben, the chicken, the slice level
boxes.text: The slice's rules on `fizz-phys`, proved bit for bit against eighteen Fizz 1 traces, with a golden replay that native, Web and DOS reproduce. It replaced the Milestone 0 marker rules, `fizz-hello`, which are deleted.

boxes.label: fizz-present-dos
boxes.text: Integer only (`clippy::float_arithmetic` denied). Host tests of the slice HUD and banner.

boxes.label: fizz-slice-view, fizz-view
boxes.text: `draw_slice` draws the slice for both presenters, including the captions, stars and puff; pinned frame digests in its tests, and `/BENCH` compares DOS frames with the host's.

boxes.label: Scene intent projection
boxes.text: Lowering tiles, sprites and lights to mode 13h. A sketch only.

boxes.label: DosClock, DosInput, DosDisplay
boxes.text: The only place the HAL traits meet the runtime. `DosClock` and `WebClock` are the two consumers of `Clock` and `Pacer`.

boxes.label: fizz-machine
boxes.text: The pure model of what a machine has, the sound plan, the check screen and the table of switches; host tests and golden screens for thirteen machines.

boxes.label: fizz-sfx
boxes.sub: the cluck on OPL and speaker
boxes.text: The OPL2, OPL3 pair and PC speaker players for the cluck, and `place`, which turns a source's position into a level for each ear. Host tests; the owner heard the cluck in a playtest, and nobody has listened on real hardware.

boxes.label: timer.rs
boxes.text: Divisor 19886 (60 Hz) and a 16-bit accumulator that chains to the BIOS handler; the modes that play sound use divisor 2131 (560 Hz) and the same accumulator. Milestone 0's replay printed `BIOS TICKS 182`; the slice's prints a count in the bound of 383 to 387.

boxes.label: kbd.rs
boxes.text: Scancodes into a local ring; `MOVED yes` from DOSBox autotype in `/LIVE`. Look, aim and jump were also typed through the X server for the screenshots.

boxes.label: vga.rs
boxes.text: Real-mode `INT 10h` through DPMI. The picture itself has not been looked at on a real display.

boxes.label: fpu.rs
boxes.text: `FPU CW 027F` after the replay.

boxes.label: audio.rs
boxes.text: Steps the cluck from the interrupt, on channel 5 or on the channel 5 and 14 pair. `tools/check-dos.sh` counts the register writes and speaker steps of each path in DOSBox; nobody has heard any of them.

boxes.label: probe.rs
boxes.text: The probes behind `/PROBE` and `/CHECK`, run under 21 DOSBox configurations; a real machine has not run them.

boxes.label: start.rs, dpmi.rs, heap.rs
boxes.text: Mirrored from Desk's d0 spike and the proof of concept.

boxes.label: irq.rs
boxes.text: Handlers return `Eoi` or `Chain`, do bounded work and never touch the x87.

boxes.label: cleanup.rs, panic.rs
boxes.text: `VECTORS RESTORED yes`, and `/PANIC` exits with status 3, also with a cluck sounding on an OPL3. The silence of the chip after exit has not been heard.

boxes.label: rust-lld, link.ld, elf2go32.py
boxes.sub: ELF to go32 with the DJGPP stub
boxes.text: No C compiler or C library. `FIZZ2.EXE` is 111,104 bytes unstripped (32,768 at Milestone 0).

boxes.label: dos-elf.json, -Zbuild-std
boxes.text: Built in the pinned `ci-dos` image in CI and from `vendor/` locally.

boxes.label: CWSDPMI and DOS
boxes.text: Not ours. Under CWSDPMI `hlt` is privileged, so pacing spins on the tick counter.

boxes.label: DOSBox Staging 0.83.0
boxes.text: Every DOS result so far. `/BENCH` runs at a fixed 26,800 cycles a millisecond; the other checks at `cycles=max`, which hides x87 cost.

boxes.label: A real 486DX
boxes.text: No physical machine, display, sound card or speaker has run FIZZ2.EXE.
